headline: Western Washington's unbeaten start ends at Westminster
dek: Western Washington had won all four of their matches before they travelled to Westminster and lost. Seattle Pacific, unbeaten too until last night, fell at Regis the same evening, and Fort Lewis's own unbeaten start ended at Northwest Nazarene.
displaced_by: results night: Western Washington's unbeaten start over at Westminster
